fixture.event.bad_harvest_1359.descripti: Local shock: the realised population falls below the regional expectation.

fixture.event.banishment_1365.descriptio: The town hall banishes the head of the Mist: an outlaw in Vaucelles.
fixture.event.banishment_1365.label: Banishment of Raoul the One-Eyed
fixture.event.charity_charter_1366.descr: The town hall recognises the Order: licit in Vaucelles.
fixture.event.charity_charter_1366.label: Charter of the Order in Vaucelles
fixture.event.charity_charter_1366.trans: Legal status of the Order in Vaucelles
fixture.event.charity_founding_1349.desc: Sister Clémence opens a hospice and a soup kitchen. Tolerated by the town hall.
fixture.event.charity_founding_1349.labe: Founding of the Order of Mercy
fixture.event.death_aubert_1374.descript: He has not been mayor since 1372.
fixture.event.death_aubert_1374.label: Death of Aubert Marchais
fixture.event.death_gautier_1368.descrip: The guild master dies; the mill passes to his son Hugues.
fixture.event.death_gautier_1368.label: Death of Gautier Perrin
fixture.event.death_guillaume_1352.descr: The mayor dies of the plague. The office stays vacant.
fixture.event.death_guillaume_1352.label: Death of Guillaume Marchais
fixture.event.debt_1356.description: In debt to the Mist, Thibaut gives up his tavern and drifts toward the Company.
fixture.event.debt_1356.label: Thibaut Marchais’s debt
fixture.event.election_1354.description: Three eligible candidates. Aubert Marchais ranks first: son of the former mayor, guild member, no tie to a proscribed group.
fixture.event.election_1354.label: Mayoral election of 1354
fixture.event.guild_charter_1344.descrip: The town hall grants the drapers a charter: the guild is licit in Vaucelles.
fixture.event.guild_charter_1344.label: Guild charter
fixture.event.guild_exit_1357.descriptio: Affiliation change: the guild parts ways with Thibaut.
fixture.event.guild_exit_1357.label: Thibaut leaves the guild
fixture.event.guild_master_1370.descript: Co-opted after two years of vacancy.
fixture.event.guild_master_1370.label: Hugues Perrin, guild master
fixture.event.heresy_trial_1362.descript: The provostry outlaws the Order for sheltering outlaws. Virtuous but proscribed.
fixture.event.heresy_trial_1362.label: Heresy trial in Montreuil
fixture.event.heresy_trial_1362.transiti: Legal status of the Order in Montreuil
fixture.event.mist_founding_1349.descrip: Raoul the One-Eyed organises smuggling across the valley. A covert group.
fixture.event.mist_founding_1349.label: Founding of the Company of the Mist
fixture.event.montreuil_charter_1371.tra: Legal status of the Order in Montreuil
fixture.event.montreuil_edict_1351.descr: The provostry outlaws the Company within its jurisdiction.
fixture.event.montreuil_edict_1351.label: Montreuil edict against the Mist
fixture.event.montreuil_edict_1351.trans: Legal status of the Mist in Montreuil
fixture.event.plague_1352.description: Enclosing epidemic: it has no effect of its own, the deaths cite it.
fixture.event.plague_1352.label: Plague of 1352
fixture.event.racket_1357.description: The Mist takes the tavern under its thumb.
fixture.event.racket_1357.label: Racket on the Rooster Tavern
fixture.event.succession_1372.descriptio: Aubert steps down; heredity is not automatic, Jehan is elected.
fixture.event.succession_1372.label: Jehan succeeds his father
fixture.event.town_edict_1358.descriptio: Mayor Aubert has the Company outlawed in Vaucelles; a dated conflict opens.
fixture.event.town_edict_1358.label: Town edict against the Mist
fixture.event.town_edict_1358.transition: Legal status of the Mist in Vaucelles
